name: Cable Chest Press
cardText:
Cable Chest Press
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
2
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
3
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward.
4
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

name: Cable Pec Fly
cardText:
Cable Pec Fly
Beginner
1
Set the cable pin at shoulder height or just above.
2
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
3
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Cable Incline Alternating Bench Press
cardText:
Cable Incline Alternating Bench Press
Beginner
1
Lie on bench, cables should be above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
2
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
3
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

name: Cable Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
Novice
1
Lie on a bench, holding cables below shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
2
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
3
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

name: Cable Alternating Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Alternating Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
Novice
1
Lie on an incline bench, holding low cables with palms facing your feet.
2
Sweep one arm above your chest while maintaining a slight elbow bend.
3
Slowly lower the handle, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Alternating Bench Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Alternating Bench Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Lie on bench, hold cable handles above chest, palms facing inward.
2
Lower one arm outward with slight elbow bend, keeping opposite arm extended.
3
Bring arm back to center, alternate sides while maintaining controlled movement.

name: Cable Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
Novice
1
Lie on a bench, holding cables at shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
2
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
3
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

name: Cable Decline Alternating Bench Press
cardText:
Cable Decline Alternating Bench Press
Beginner
1
Lie on bench, with cables above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
2
Press one handle downward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
3
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

name: Cable Alternating Decline Bench Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Alternating Decline Bench Chest Fly
Novice
1
Lay on bench with cables above shoulder level.
2
Start with both arms extended out.
3
Bring one arm forward and downward, while keeping the other arm in the same position.
4
Alternate arms until you complete the allotted amount of reps.

name: Cable Decline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Decline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
Novice
1
Lay on bench with cables above shoulder level.
2
Sweep both handles in front of your chest while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
3
Squeeze your chest, then lower the handles under control.

name: Cable Alternating Bench Press
cardText:
Cable Alternating Bench Press
Beginner
1
Lie on bench, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
2
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
3
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

name: Cable Standing Svend Press
cardText:
Cable Standing Svend Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from low cables, pressing both handles together at your chest.
2
Extend your arms forward while continuously squeezing the handles together.
3
Pause briefly, then return the handles toward your chest.

name: Cable Push Pull
cardText:
Cable Push Pull
Beginner
1
Stand between cables, holding one handle near your chest and one forward.
2
Press one arm forward while pulling the opposite elbow backward.
3
Reverse the movement under control, then switch your stance and arms.

name: Cable Standing Incline Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Standing Incline Chest Fly
Beginner

name: Cable Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Internally Rotated Chest Fly
Novice
1
Lay on bench with cables at shoulder level.
2
Sweep both handles in front of your chest while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
3
Squeeze your chest, then lower the handles under control.

name: Cable Decline Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Decline Internally Rotated Chest Fly
Novice
1
Lie on a bench, holding cables higher than shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
2
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
3
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

name: Cable Decline Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Decline Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Place the cable anchor at a higher level than your shoulders.
2
Sit on the bench, leave your elbows mostly extended.
3
Bring your fists together and flex your pecs.

name: Cable Incline Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Incline Internally Rotated Chest Fly
Novice
1
Lie on a bench, holding cables lower than shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
2
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
3
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

name: Cable Standing Incline Chest Press
cardText:
Cable Standing Incline Chest Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
2
Press both handles forward and upward until your arms are extended.
3
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Press
cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
2
Press one handle forward and upward until your arm is extended.
3
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with slight arm bend.
2
Bring arm across chest in a smooth arc without rotating your torso.
3
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly to starting position.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
Intermediate
1
Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at shoulder height, arm slightly bent.
2
Rotate palm inward and bring arm across chest in a sweeping arc.
3
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly while maintaining internal rotation.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Press
cardText:
Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Press
Novice
1
Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with elbow bent.
2
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
3
Squeeze chest at extension, then return handle slowly to starting position.

name: Cable Incline Fly Around
cardText:
Cable Incline Fly Around
Novice
1
Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
2
Fly arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

name: Cable Incline Press Around
cardText:
Cable Incline Press Around
Novice
1
Set cables slightly below shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
2
Press arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

name: Cable Decline Press Around
cardText:
Cable Decline Press Around
Novice
1
Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
2
Press arm forward and downward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Stand between low cables with arms extended and palms facing downward.
2
Sweep one handle upward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
3
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Stand between low cables with your arms extended outward.
2
Sweep one handle upward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
3
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Stand between cables with arms extended outward and palms facing downward.
2
Sweep one handle across your chest while maintaining a slight elbow bend.
3
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Stand between cables, hold cable handles above chest, palms facing inward.
2
Lower one arm outward with slight elbow bend, keeping opposite arm extended.
3
Bring arm back to center, alternate sides while maintaining controlled movement.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Decline Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Decline Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Stand between high cables with arms extended and palms facing downward.
2
Sweep one handle downward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
3
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Fly
cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Fly
Beginner
1
Stand between high cables with your arms extended outward.
2
Sweep one handle downward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
3
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Press
cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from high cables with handles beside your chest.
2
Press one handle forward and downward until your arm is extended.
3
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Standing Decline Chest Press
cardText:
Cable Standing Decline Chest Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from high cables with handles beside your chest.
2
Press both handles forward and downward until your arms are extended.
3
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Chest Press
cardText:
Cable Standing Alternating Chest Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from the cables with handles beside your chest.
2
Press one handle forward until your arm is fully extended.
3
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.
